name: K-2SO
description: K-2SO was a modified KX-series security droid who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Originally created for the Imperial Army, the droid was deployed in 2 BBY as part of the Galactic Empire's efforts to quell protests on the planet Ghorman. After the Ghorman Massacre and encountering the Axis network operative Cassian Jeron Andor, K-2SO was incapacitated by Samm, a member of the Ghorman Front, and salvaged by Andor. Upon their return to the Great Temple rebel base on Yavin 4, K-2SO was repaired and reprogrammed to serve the Rebel Alliance. The droid became a friend and companion to Andor on various missions for the Alliance. In 1 BBY, K-2SO participated in the rescue of the Axis network rebel Kleya Marki, along with the rebel Ruescott Melshi. Marki would pass along intelligence about a secret Imperial weapon that the Alliance would soon learn was the Death Star battle station, a moon-sized superweapon.
